business_profile.business_overview: Rejuvenate Salon & Spa is a premier luxury salon and spa in Dhaka, located in Uttara (Unimart Centrepoint) with 3+ branches and a 4.9-star rating. Services span hair, facials, spa treatments, and bridal preparation. Appointments are booked by phone only — there is no online booking system. High-ticket, appointment-driven services with a strong reputation but manual intake.
business_profile.offer_surface: Autonomous AI agent deployment for Luxury salon and spa — targeting: Online appointment booking into stylists'/therapists' real-time availability; Service and pricing enquiry handling; Pre-visit reminders to cut no-shows; Bridal package consultation booking; Multi-branch routing across 3+ locations

pricing_knowledge.model: High-ticket salon & spa services — hair, facial, spa, bridal prep
pricing_knowledge.note: Appointment-driven, high-margin services. No-shows and missed phone bookings directly cut revenue. Online booking with real-time availability + automated reminders is the highest-leverage automation for a luxury salon.

business_profile.competitive_position: Rejuvenate competes with other premium Dhaka salons. Their edge is a 4.9-star luxury reputation and multiple branches. But phone-only booking is a friction point that loses appointments to salons offering online booking. An AI booking agent with real-time availability and reminders would match their luxury positioning with a frictionless booking experience.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With high-ticket services and 3+ branches, appointment volume is significant. If phone-only booking misses after-hours calls and no-shows eat into high-margin treatments, that's real recurring leakage. An AI booking + reminder agent fills slots, cuts no-shows, and captures after-hours booking demand.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI booking agent that shows real-time stylist/therapist availability and books instantly.
2. Service + pricing enquiry agent answering treatment questions.
3. Pre-visit reminder agent cutting no-shows.
4. Bridal package consultation booking + multi-branch routing.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A client wants a facial before a Friday event and messages Rejuvenate at 10pm: 'Any slots for a gold facial Thursday?' The AI replies instantly: 'Yes — Thursday we have 2pm or 5pm with [therapist] at our Uttara branch. The gold facial is ৳X. Shall I book 5pm?' The client books; a reminder is set for Wednesday. Rejuvenate captured an after-hours appointment it would have missed on a phone line.
